{
  "technical_and_design_decisions": [
    "Extend the existing Spring XD and Ambari plugin mechanisms rather than introducing a new deployment or configuration subsystem.",
    "Implement Ambari-installed Spring XD on YARN as an explicit, backward-compatible deployment option using existing Ambari configuration and service lifecycle patterns.",
    "Integrate spring-cloud-config-server through the existing Spring Bus configuration/bootstrap flow, preserving local property configuration as a fallback.",
    "Use repeatable profiling and benchmark tests for Spring Integration channel performance and XD serialization measurements, with representative message and payload sizes.",
    "Implement file:// support by selecting Hadoop LocalFileSystem through the existing fsUri abstraction, without attempting cross-machine file distribution.",
    "Pass Sqoop system properties as a controlled set of JVM arguments to the spawned Sqoop process, with appropriate escaping and validation.",
    "Maintain compatibility with the Spring XD 1.2 GA and existing Ambari plugin packaging and upgrade conventions.",
    "Use automated unit, integration, regression, and acceptance tests where practical, with manual validation for Ambari deployment and multi-process behavior."
  ],
  "assumptions": [
    "The existing Spring XD, Spring Integration, Ambari plugin, Hadoop, and Sqoop source code and build infrastructure are available and buildable.",
    "The increment is implemented by one developer familiar with Java, Spring, Hadoop/YARN, Ambari, and the existing project architecture.",
    "The requested Ambari functionality is limited to the stated installation, deployment, and upgrade paths; no redesign of Ambari itself is required.",
    "Spring XD 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA is a compatible upgrade supported by the existing plugin model, with no database migration or large-scale data migration required.",
    "Spring Cloud Config Server connectivity uses standard HTTP-based configuration retrieval and does not require implementing a custom configuration backend.",
    "Security hardening, high availability, encryption, and authentication for the configuration server are outside the increment unless already provided by the existing platform.",
    "Performance investigations produce actionable findings and targeted corrective changes, but do not require achieving a specific numerical performance target.",
    "Serialization baselines cover the currently supported serialization paths and representative payloads rather than every possible connector or data type.",
    "file:// is intended primarily for single-node or user-managed shared-file scenarios; distributed file staging and validation of file availability on every container host are excluded.",
    "Sqoop system properties are supplied through the existing job configuration or command-line configuration mechanism, and only properties explicitly permitted by the implementation are forwarded.",
    "Documentation is updated in the project's existing format and includes setup, upgrade, configuration, and usage examples.",
    "Estimates include implementation, developer testing, review preparation, and defect correction, but exclude elapsed waiting time for external teams or infrastructure."
  ],
  "activities": [
    {
      "activity_id": "A1",
      "activity_name": "Increment analysis and implementation planning",
      "activity_description": "Inspect the existing Spring XD, Spring Bus, Ambari plugin, Hadoop filesystem, Sqoop launch, build, and test structures; map each user story to affected modules and define implementation and acceptance boundaries.",
      "most_likely_effort": 2
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A2",
      "activity_name": "Ambari Spring XD on YARN deployment option",
      "activity_description": "Add the Ambari configuration and deployment option for Spring XD installed on YARN, update service lifecycle and configuration handling, and add unit and integration coverage for installation and startup behavior.",
      "most_likely_effort": 9
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A3",
      "activity_name": "Spring Cloud Config Server integration for Spring Bus",
      "activity_description": "Integrate spring-cloud-config-server property retrieval into Spring Bus modules, define precedence and fallback behavior, update module configuration, and test startup, refresh, missing-property, and connectivity scenarios.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A4",
      "activity_name": "Spring Integration channel performance investigation and remediation",
      "activity_description": "Profile SI 4.2 channel behavior, create reproducible performance tests, identify bottlenecks, implement targeted corrective changes, and compare results against the baseline while checking for regressions.",
      "most_likely_effort": 11
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A5",
      "activity_name": "XD serialization baseline measurements",
      "activity_description": "Define representative XD serialization workloads and payloads, implement repeatable measurement tooling, capture throughput, latency, allocation, and payload-size characteristics, and record improvement opportunities.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A6",
      "activity_name": "Spring Bus architecture and specification review",
      "activity_description": "Review the current Spring Bus architecture and design specifications, identify foundation-level gaps and inconsistencies, and produce prioritized design recommendations and follow-up items.",
      "most_likely_effort": 5
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A7",
      "activity_name": "Ambari plugin upgrade from XD 1.2 RC to 1.2 GA",
      "activity_description": "Update plugin metadata, package references, compatibility checks, and upgrade handling for Spring XD 1.2 GA; execute upgrade validation from the RC installation and document the user procedure.",
      "most_likely_effort": 7
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A8",
      "activity_name": "Hadoop LocalFileSystem file:// support",
      "activity_description": "Update fsUri parsing and filesystem selection so file:// resolves to Hadoop LocalFileSystem, preserve existing distributed filesystem behavior, and add tests for local paths, URI handling, and jdbchdfs usage.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A9",
      "activity_name": "Sqoop child-process system property forwarding",
      "activity_description": "Add configuration for user-specified Sqoop JVM system properties, validate and safely quote values, append them to the spawned Java process, and test memory and connector-specific property scenarios.",
      "most_likely_effort": 6
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A10",
      "activity_name": "Cross-feature integration, regression, and acceptance testing",
      "activity_description": "Run the full build and regression suite, validate interactions among configuration, deployment, filesystem, and process-launch changes, perform representative Ambari/YARN and local execution tests, and correct discovered defects.",
      "most_likely_effort": 8
    },
    {
      "activity_id": "A11",
      "activity_name": "Documentation, release notes, and delivery preparation",
      "activity_description": "Finalize configuration references, Ambari installation and upgrade instructions, file:// and Sqoop examples, performance findings, architecture review outputs, release notes, and implementation handoff materials.",
      "most_likely_effort": 4
    }
  ],
  "reported_total": {
    "most_likely_effort": 72
  }
}

technical_and_design_decisions: Extend the existing Spring XD and Ambari plugin mechanisms rather than introducing a new deployment or configuration subsystem.
Implement Ambari-installed Spring XD on YARN as an explicit, backward-compatible deployment option using existing Ambari configuration and service lifecycle patterns.
Integrate spring-cloud-config-server through the existing Spring Bus configuration/bootstrap flow, preserving local property configuration as a fallback.
Use repeatable profiling and benchmark tests for Spring Integration channel performance and XD serialization measurements, with representative message and payload sizes.
Implement file:// support by selecting Hadoop LocalFileSystem through the existing fsUri abstraction, without attempting cross-machine file distribution.
Pass Sqoop system properties as a controlled set of JVM arguments to the spawned Sqoop process, with appropriate escaping and validation.
Maintain compatibility with the Spring XD 1.2 GA and existing Ambari plugin packaging and upgrade conventions.
Use automated unit, integration, regression, and acceptance tests where practical, with manual validation for Ambari deployment and multi-process behavior.
